title: Spectral Ruleset Structure
description: Documentation of the Spectral ruleset file format (.spectral.yml) used by Stoplight for API governance

fields.name: extends
fields.description: Base rulesets to extend. Use 'spectral:oas' for OpenAPI or 'spectral:asyncapi' for AsyncAPI.

fields.name: rules
fields.description: Custom rule definitions or overrides of extended rules

fields.name: given
fields.description: JSONPath expression(s) targeting nodes to evaluate

fields.name: then
fields.description: Assertion(s) to apply to the target nodes

fields.name: functionOptions
fields.description: Options for the assertion function (e.g. {match: '^[a-z]+'} for pattern)

fields.name: functionsDir
fields.description: Relative path to directory containing custom JavaScript/TypeScript functions

fields.name: formats
fields.description: Format identifiers restricting which documents this ruleset applies to

functions.truthy: Passes if the value is truthy
functions.falsy: Passes if the value is falsy
functions.defined: Passes if the value is not undefined
functions.undefined: Passes if the value is undefined
functions.pattern: Validates value matches or doesn't match a regex
functions.schema: Validates value against a JSON Schema
functions.enumeration: Validates value is in a list of allowed values
functions.alphabetical: Validates object keys or array values are sorted alphabetically
functions.casing: Validates string follows a naming convention (camel, pascal, snake, kebab, etc.)
functions.xor: Validates that exactly one of the specified properties is present
